constraints.forbidden_meaning: Tablo-351-5 establishes or defines the minimum C25/30 strength class.

forbidden_meaning_patterns.matching: reference marker AND attribution marker anywhere in the unit, AND one clause in which a class designation follows a strength-class noun

historical_evidence.note: The unit that motivated the constraint. It is a regression case, not the matching rule.

constraints.required_action: State Tablo-351-5 as what it is - the acceptance criteria for the class - and state the class requirement itself from SEC-02-2-C-001, in its own sentence.
constraints.required_meaning: Tablo-351-5 provides 28-day core-sample acceptance criteria for C25/30 shotcrete.

required_meaning_markers.scope_rationale: A qualifier lives outside the claim's own sentence by definition - that is what makes it a qualifier - so demanding it inside the unit would reject a faithful rendering of the claim's canonical wording. This follows the parent contract's condition policy rather than inventing a stricter scope for one claim.

safe_relationship.rule: Both claims may be stated, separately. The draft must not imply that SEC-02-2-C-002 proves SEC-02-2-C-001; no approved relationship supports that inference.

generality_note: A claim acquires this rule by carrying a registered constraint and declaring the matching requirement scope, not by being named in validator code. The pilot's exact wording appears nowhere in the matching logic.
rationale: The first pilot proved that the distinction between a requirement and the table that tests it is easy to lose in drafting. A general instruction to preserve qualifiers is necessary and was not sufficient, so the boundary is also enforced deterministically.
